label: Opening Hook
text: In northern Iran runs a 195-kilometre ancient wall of red brick that few people have ever heard of.
title: File:Great Wall of Gorgan - panoramio.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Built by the Sasanian Empire, probably in the 5th-6th century AD About 195 km long, with more than 30 forts Made of fired red bricks and fed by a canal system, hence the nickname 'Red Snake' Possibly garrisoned by tens of thousands of soldiers Among the longest defensive walls of the ancient world
